KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SCRAPMETAL: So many things in the old world were constructed out of metal.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_OLDBATTERIES: They used to power meaningful things, but those days are long gone.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_OLDCIRCUITBOARD: Once considered state-of-the-art technology, now its only worth lies in the materials you can salvage from it.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_CONTAMINATEDWATER: You'd have to be truly desperate to even consider drinking this.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_JUNK: Can be refined into more useful material.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BASICPART: Used in medium and high tier item crafting.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_REFINEDMATERIAL: Processed material ready to be used or converted into crafting components.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_CRAFTINGCOMPONENT: Used directly in crafting items of all tiers.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LEAKYCANISTER: An old, corroded canister containing some presumably hazardous liquid.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_INDUSTRIALBATTERY: Speranza gets most of its power from a large, repaired solar grid system above ground and relies on batteries to supply the rest.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_INDUSTRIALMAGNET: Surprisingly strong. Fortunately, it has a release mechanism so you can carry it safely in your pack.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SPEAKER: There are speakers in all common areas as part of the Speranza-wide PA system. Some of them have been repurposed into playing music between announcements, a welcome respite for those who gather in these areas.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TRANSPONDER: Receives and emits signals. It's in pretty rough shape, but still functional.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SYRINGE: You're going to have to sterilize this at least twice before you use it. Actually, why stop there?
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DUCTTAPE: A trusted solution to all of life's little emergencies. Sometimes the big ones too.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TUBEBRUSH: A reliable tool for removing rust from narrow spaces.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_METALFILE: Not in the best shape, but still useful for smoothing out rough edges.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_REFINEDPOLYMER: A staple of the old world, for better or worse.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ALUMINUMPLATES: Shiny. You can almost see your own reflection on the surface.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ADHESIVE: A concerning amount of things in Speranza are held together with "spit and glue" according to Apollo.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_CLEANWATER: Fresh water. A sight for sore eyes in this day and age.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_REFINEDRUBBER: An elastic sheet of synthetic rubber.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MECHANICALCOMPONENTS: Assorted metal hardware, bound to have some kind of use.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ELECTRICALCOMPONENTS: A handy pile of fuses, cable spools, resistors, and other similar items.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ANTISEPTIC: A key ingredient for making Vita.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LIGHTGUNPARTS: Assorted spare parts used for pistols and SMGs.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MEDIUMGUNPARTS: Assorted spare parts used for rifles.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_HEAVYGUNPARTS: Assorted spare parts used to improve handcannons and snipers.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TRADERITEM: Used directly in crafting items of all tiers. Can reliably be bought in Speranza.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RUSTREMOVER: Dissolves rust without damaging the affected object too much in the process.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_GUNPOWDER: The first step towards crafting some bullets.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SURGICALNEEDLE: Probably the cleanest thing within a 100-mile radius.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SIMPLEGRENADECASINGS: Take them to the Tinkering Bench and pour something into them.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ADVANCEDGRENADECASING: Well suited for crafting more elaborate types of grenades.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SENSORS: These have a wide range of uses.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TORCHGINGERSEEDS: For optimal growth, plant these in a garden exposed to partial shade. Or just somewhere in your chambers.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_PLANTSANDSEEDS: Can be found in the wild or grown in your chambers.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TORCHGINGER: Lance grows these in the Med Bay. He also talks tenderly to them in the evenings.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MUZZLECOMPONENTS: A crucial component for crafting muzzles for your weapons.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RAIDERHATCHKEY: This could be your ticket back home, if you can find a place to use it at.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AGAVE: A piece of an agave leaf. Can be used to regain a small amount of health.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_APRICOT: A sun ripe apricot. Can be consumed for a small amount of stamina.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LEMON: Can be consumed for a small amount of stamina.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MOSS: Can be used to regain a small amount of health.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MUSHROOM: Can be consumed to regain a small amount of health.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_OLIVES: Can be consumed for a small amount of stamina.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_PRICKLYPEAR: Can be consumed for a small amount of stamina.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RESIN: Can be used to gradually restore a small amount of health over time.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ENERGYAMMO: Ammo used for energy weapons. One clip will fully charge a single weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_HEAVYAMMO: Heavy bullets used mainly with sniper rifles and hand cannons.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LIGHTAMMO: Light bullets used mainly with SMGs and light handguns.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MEDIUMAMMO: Medium bullets used with some assault rifles and battle rifles.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BLUEGATEKEY1: Unlocks a door to the confiscated goods area within the Blue Gate tunnels
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BLUEGATEKEY2: Unlocks a door by the Communication Tower near the Blue Gate
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BLUEGATEKEY3: Unlocks a door to one of the old Village buildings near the Blue Gate
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BURIEDCITYKEY1: Unlocks a door in the Hospital in Buried City
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BURIEDCITYKEY2: Unlocks a door in the J Kozma Ventures company building in Buried City
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BURIEDCITYKEY3: Unlocks the door to the Town Hall in Buried City
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BURIEDCITYKEY4: Unlocks certain apartment doors in Buried City
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FIREBALLBURNER: The nasty, but useful, part of the Fireball's innards.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ARCPOWERCELL: Valuable resource that drops from all ARC enemies.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ARMORBATTERIES: Used to maintain shields. Can be bought from Lance
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BLOATEDTUNACAN: Something tells you that you don't want to open this...
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SPACEPORTKEY1: Unlocks a door in Control Tower A6 in Spaceport
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SPACEPORTKEY2: Unlocks a door to the Trench Towers in Spaceport
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SPACEPORTKEY3: Unlocks a door in the Container Storage in Spaceport
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SPACEPORTKEY4: Unlocks a door in the Shipping Warehouse in Spaceport
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DAMKEY1: Unlocks a door in the Testing Annex on Dam Battlegrounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DAMKEY2: Unlocks a door to the Control Tower on Dam Battlegrounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DAMKEY3: Unlocks a door in the Research and Administration building on Dam Battlegrounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DAMKEY4: Unlocks a door in the Water Treatment Control building on Dam Battlegrounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AIRFRESHENER: Contains hints of pine, lavender, and traffic jam-induced despair.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BENTCLOTHESHANGER: If you encounter a matching set, consider yourself lucky.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BLOWNFUSES: Scorched and useless. The burnt metal smells faintly like Apollo's workshop.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SNOWGLOBES: The envy of every Speranzan. Proof that this world was once thriving and magical.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BURNTOUTCANDLES: After the grid fell candles became the preferred source of light for many. Unlike electricity, a good old candle will never fail you. Unless it's windy. Or raining. Or...
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_COFFEEPOT: The power to face a new day, one drip at a time.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DEFLATEDFOOTBALL: Just by looking at this, you too start to feel slightly deflated.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DOGCOLLAR: After all this time, you can still smell the goodness.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_EXPIREDRESPIRATOR: The filters are clogged with sand and noxious fumes. Long past its lifespan.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FADEDPHOTOGRAPH: A snapshot of the world before, faded by sunlight and time.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FOODWRAPPER: The vibrant colors and natural stickiness have made them a favorite among the more artistic Speranzans.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_GARLICPRESS: It'll press garlic, olives, and probably many other things.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_HUSKLILY: These beautiful, but toxic flowers only grow around Baron husks. As for why, your guess is as good as anyone's.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ICECREAMSCOOPER: It is theorized that scooping things was a favorite pastime in the world before.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LANCESMIXTAPE5THEDITION: Lance has personally planted a number of these around the Rust Belt, for some reason.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LIGHTBULB: Without light, life underground would be impossible.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_OILSHROOM: These mushrooms thrive on a wide range of pollutants: oil spills, heavy metals, pesticides, you name it! It goes without saying that you shouldn't eat them.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_PIANOKEYS: Useless on their own, and yet..
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_PLASTICSPINNER: A miniature dynamo of unparalleled efficiency, far beyond our comprehension. Must have powered great machines.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_PLAYINGCARDS: Speranzans love to see who can build the tallest tower - before the tremors knock them down.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RIPPEDSAFETYVEST: A remnant of a time long lost, when it was fashionable to stand out.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RUBBERDUCK: Always there to lend an ear, should you need it.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SCARYWOODENDOLL: Raiders like to prank each other by leaving these in dimly-lit places.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SCRATCHEDSUNGLASSES: Impossible to see through, but walking into things never looked so good.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TORNBOOK: What pages remain speak of chosen heroes, vampires, and lots of longing glances.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TORNLACETABLECLOTH: There's craftsmanship in every stitch, long lost to time.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BLUEGATEKEY4: Unlocks the rear door of a patrol car
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_POSTER_NATURAL_WONDERS: If you stand close and squint your eyes, it's like the world never came crumbling down.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MUSIC_ALBUM: Perfect for relaxing nights at home, casual get-togethers, and private air guitar concerts.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RED_CORAL_JEWELRY: Valued for its fine craftsmanship, and effortless ability to make your eyes pop.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FINE_WRISTWATCH: Perfect for telling the time, and showcasing that you're an exceedingly dignified person.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_VERY_COMFORTABLE_PILLOW: The envy of every Raider. Like sleeping on an especially ergonomic cloud.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SILVER_TEASPOON_SET: A shining, shimmering set of refinement and elegance.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DART_BOARD: Some Raiders use it to practice dexterity. Others just like throwing things at other things.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_CAT_BED: At least a tiny bit more comfortable than your face.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AUGMENTATIONS: Can be equipped to gain more loadout space and carry capacity. Allows you to equip better shields as well.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LAUNCHERAMMO: Anti-ARC payloads used mainly by the Hullcracker.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BLUEGATEKEY5: Unlocks certain cellar doors near the Blue Gate
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_MAGNET: Fun thing to put on a fridgerator.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_MOUNTAINCOMPOUNDKEY1: Unlocks a door in the Security Checkpoint in Stella Montis
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_UNLOCKS_A_DOOR_IN_ME: Unlocks a door in Medical Research in Stella Montis
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_UNLOCKS_A_DOOR_IN_TH: Unlocks a door in the Archives in Stella Montis
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SECURITYCODE: Temporary security code to unlock the main gate.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ACERRAKEY: Unlocks certain kinds of doors throughout Acerra.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DAMUTILITYKEY: Unlocks certain kinds of doors throughout the Dam.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_UNARMED: For when you want to be 'armless!
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BUNKER_KEY_IN_STOCK: Lets you purchase more Outskirts Bunker Keys from Tian Wen.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BROKENPARACHUTE: Torn and mangled beyond repair. Seems like someone had a rough landing.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BROKENACCORDION: The torn bellows are sadder than any song one could have played on this instrument.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BROKENBATON: Bent and broken, this baton looks more like an art project than a weapon.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BROKENRIOTSHIELD: With cracked plastic and a broken handle, this piece of junk should be ashamed to call itself a shield.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BROKENHANDCUFFS: You won't be restraining anyone with these.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTION_MOUNTAINCOMPOUNDKEY4: Unlocks a door in Assembly in Stella Montis
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_CANDLEBERRIES: A waxy berry that grows only during a small window each year. People have depended on them to make candles, foods and medicine for ages.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FLASHYDUCK: Lovingly hand-painted by someone of great talent—clearly. Any guesses who?
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ALIENDUCK: A long, long way from home.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TROPICALDUCK: It quietly dreams of taking to the skies with its brethren.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FAMILIARDUCK: Unlike the real one, this one fits in your pack.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DOODLYDUCK: Everything is a canvas to a creative child.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_SECURITYCODE_ALT2:
Temporary security code to unlock the main gate.

Will expire upon returning to Speranza.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_EXPIRED_SECURITYCODE: An expired security code. Has no more practical use.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DAMKEY5: Unlocks a door in the Controlled Access Zone on Dam Battlegrounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RIVENTIDES_HOTELKEY1: Unlocks the door to one of Panorama Azzurro's many suites at Riven Tides.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RIVENTIDES_CRANEHOUSEKEY: Unlocks a door in one of the Crane Houses at Riven Tides.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RIVENTIDES_WAVEBREAKERKEY1: Unlocks a door to the Classified Records room in the Port Authority Building at Riven Tides.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RIVENTIDES_WAVEBREAKERKEY2: Unlocks a door to the Secure Storage room in the Port Authority Building at Riven Tides.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_RIVENTIDES_HOTELKEY2: Unlocks the door to one of Panorama Azzurro's many suites at Riven Tides, but the room number appears to be scratched out.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_BOATMODEL_A_PLACEHOL: Undaunted in the face of its larger brethren, this nimble one-master has been known to brave even the most just-above-average of waves.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_BOATMODEL_B_PLACEHOL: A spirited up-and-comer, this two-master has been known to sail ever so slightly beyond the horizon.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_BOATMODEL_C_PLACEHOL: A majestic sight in any era, this fierce merchant ship is indifferent to the aerodynamic benefits of fiberglass technology.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_BOATMODEL_D_PLACEHOL: Optimized for performance, this marvel of technology sure hopes you weren't planning on packing a particularly elaborate lunch.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_BOATMODEL_E_PLACEHOL: With the Mediterranean sun glistening off its hull, this vibrant yacht is the timeless epitome of saltwater splendour.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BOOM_PART: A throwable ARC part that triggers after a short time, sending an explosive straight down.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_PAINT_DESCRIPTION: Used to apply stencils to weapons.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_FRIGATEMEMORYMODULE_: Found in the trail of ARC Frigates, the electromagnetic signatures of these nodes turn out to be partially decipherable.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_ARCMEMORYCARD_DESCRI: A secondary data module found in a range of ARC machines.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_EXODUSBOOK_DESCRIPTI: Filled with equal parts obscure jargon and complex diagrams.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_RAIDERJOURNAL_DESCRI: Surprisingly dilligent notetaking, in surprisingly legible handwriting.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_OLDBOOK_DESCRIPTION: Filled with dog-eared pages and coffee stains, an inquisitive mind may find wisdom nonetheless.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_FRIGATE1_DESCRIPTION: Can be used to upgrade the Research Station.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_COLLECTOR1_DESCRIPTI: Can be used to upgrade the Gunsmith.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_WINNERDUCK: If there was a rubber duck competition, this one would win.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FROZEN_TRAIL_STATION_KEY: Unlocks a door in the Almatera Station on Pendola Pass.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FROZEN_TRAIL_VILLAGE_KEY: Unlocks a door to an apartment in the Old Town on Pendola Pass.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FROZEN_TRAIL_RAILYARD_KEY: Unlocks a door in the Controlled Receiving Facility on Pendola Pass.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FROZEN_TRAIL_OBSERVATORY_KEY: Unlocks a door in the Cielo Sereno Observatory main building on Pendola Pass.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_BRONZESTATUETTE: An aged but beautiful bronze statuette. Rumor has it that the Nomad Envoy collects these.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_ASCENSIONFRAGMENTS_D: Obtained through recycling and used to repair amplified weapons.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ARCADEDUCK: For some reason, it feels oddly nostalgic.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FROZENTRAIL_COLLECTORKEY: Combining three distinct couplers, this conduit seems to fit into the Fallen Emperor at Pendola Pass.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_FROZENTRAIL_COLLECTORKEYCOMP: One of three distinct couplers found in ARC machines, said to combine into a singular conduit.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AMPLIFICATION_MODULE_MK1: Advanced ARC technology that unlocks common weapon Amplification.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AMPLIFICATION_MODULE_MK2: Advanced ARC technology that unlocks uncommon weapon Amplification.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AMPLIFICATION_MODULE_MK3: Advanced ARC technology that unlocks rare weapon Amplification.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AMPLIFICATION_MODULE_MK4: Advanced ARC technology that unlocks epic weapon Amplification.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_AMPLIFICATION_MODULE_MK5: Advanced ARC technology that unlocks legendary weapon Amplification.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_POTTEDPLANT: A small but tenacious plant, growing happily in a pot
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESCRIPTIONS_STENCILPARTS_DESCRIP: Used to apply Stencils to weapons.

ID_ITEMDESC_SECURITYCODE_ALT2.Note: This is the same description as ID_ITEMDESC_SECURITYCODE, but with an added paragraph to clarify that it will expire upon leaving the round.

ID_ITEMDESC_EXPIRED_SECURITYCODE.Note: The security codes for Ancient Fort, Pilgrims Peak, Raiders Refuge and Reinforced Reception will expire and transform into this item upon leaving the round.
